question: In the top row of Figure 6.5, compare the temperature and PM2.5 maps: where are high temperatures concentrated and where is high air pollution concentrated?
answer: In the top row of Figure 6.5, high temperatures are concentrated in the southern part of the country and parts of the central region, while high air pollution (PM2.5) is concentrated in the northern part of the country (Red River Delta). [p179-figure-6.5]
